correctness.rationale: The product projection and even-palindrome obstruction reduce the language to disjoint odd alternating words. Each finite exponent contributes precisely two oriented prefix quotients for each length below its largest permitted odd length, and all terminal finite-prefix quotients merge into the same {epsilon} residual. Each infinite factor contributes exactly four orientation/parity quotients. Initial and sink residuals are separate. Explicit suffixes or maximal accepted completion lengths distinguish every quotient. A total automaton realizes the count, and separately implemented partition refinement checked 2,913 parameter tuples plus 1,121,923 direct word memberships. Finite tests corroborate rather than prove the universal result.

originality.rationale: Bapat (arXiv:2609.29022, pp. 1, 5, 13) establishes which Coxeter palindrome languages are regular, and the disjoint-union reduction, but does not determine the complete minimal DFA count for all finite and infinite dihedral products. Its displayed four-state recognizer for a single infinite-dihedral factor admits the nonreduced input stt under its printed transitions; a true complete recognizer needs six states by the new lower bound. Biagioli--Hohlweg--Sasso (arXiv:2602.16361, Example 3.3) classifies dihedral reflection words/prefixes, but not the minimal Myhill--Nerode quotient. Searches of the research database and the literature for the exact formula, dual descriptions, minimal DFA and component products found no dominating match. Remaining uncertainty: possible older unindexed minimal-DFA work.

value.rationale: The recently settled regularity criterion leaves the exact state-complexity invariant unresolved. This is a complete classification over all finite/infinite dihedral exponents and arbitrary numbers of factors, not an arbitrary finite sample: it identifies parity plateaus, the precise cost of each infinite factor, and the nonadditive sharing of accepting terminal quotients. It also supplies a correct minimal complete recognizer where a displayed four-state recognizer for a basic motivating case is insufficient. The full structural classification and lower bound, not only that local discrepancy, constitute the value.
